# Aqsa Rashid - Complete Professional Profile & Service Documentation

## About Aqsa Rashid
Aqsa Rashid is a Google Certified Web UI/UX Designer and Webflow Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan (PKT / UTC+5). She works with SaaS founders, product teams, marketing agencies, and international brands across the USA, UK, Germany, UAE, and worldwide.

### Academic & Professional Certifications
1. **Google UX Design Professional Specialization** (Coursera / Google Recognized)
   - User Research & Persona Mapping
   - Low-to-High Fidelity Wireframing in Figma
   - Interactive Prototyping & Usability Testing
   - Accessibility Standards (WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast & Navigation)
2. **Print & Digital Elements of Design** (University of Colorado Boulder)
   - Typography Scale & Visual Hierarchy
   - Color Theory & Brand Design Systems

---

## Services & Technical Offerings

### Tier 1: User Experience & Web UI Design
- **Toolchain**: Figma (Auto-Layout 5.0), Figma Tokens, Illustrator
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Low & High-Fidelity Wireframes
  - Responsive Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) frames
  - Design Tokens (Color Palette Variables, Typography Scales, Spacing Systems)
  - Interactive Figma Prototypes with component variants
- **Turnaround Time**: 1–2 Weeks
- **Target Clients**: SaaS Founders, Product Managers, & Tech Startups

### Tier 2: Figma to Webflow Development
- **Toolchain**: Webflow, Client-First BEM Class Architecture, Custom HTML/CSS/JS, Webflow IX2
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Manual, pixel-perfect Figma translation to Webflow
  - Client-First naming methodology for easy client handoff
  - Dynamic Webflow CMS Collections (Blog, Portfolio, Team)
  - Custom IX2 micro-interactions & smooth page transitions
  - On-page SEO & 100/100 Core Web Vitals optimization
- **Turnaround Time**: 2–3 Weeks
- **Target Clients**: Businesses Needing a Fast, Live, & Performant Website

### Tier 3: Social Media Branding & Campaign Assets
- **Toolchain**: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Educational Instagram Multi-Slide Carousels (1080x1350px)
  - High-Conversion Meta (Facebook/Instagram) & Google Display Ad Banners
  - Outdoor Billboard & Print Event Campaign Mockups
  - Brand Palette & Reusable Social Templates
- **Turnaround Time**: 3–5 Days
- **Target Clients**: E-Commerce Brands, Growth Marketers, & Agencies

- **Role**: Lead UI/UX Designer

- **Results**: +35% Conversion Intent, -42% Mobile Bounce Rate.

### 2. Soller & Aetherfield Clean Energy Website
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer & Webflow Developer
- **Scope**: End-to-end Figma to Webflow build featuring custom interactive ROI energy calculator and CMS integration.
- **Results**: +210% Consultation Bookings, 100/100 Google Core Web Vitals Score.

### 3. Apex Fitness Club Social Media Campaign
- **Role**: Visual Brand Designer

- **Results**: +450% Social Engagement Growth, 50k+ Total Campaign Impressions.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How quickly do you reply to new project inquiries?
A: Direct form submissions and emails sent to hi.aqsarashid@gmail.com are reviewed and answered within 24 hours (Monday through Saturday).

Q: What deliverables do I receive upon project completion?
A: For UI/UX design, you receive fully organized Figma files with Auto-Layout 5.0 components and design token specifications. For Webflow development, the site is transferred directly to your Webflow workspace with Client-First documentation.

Q: How are payment milestones structured?
A: Standard projects operate on a 50% deposit upfront to reserve bandwidth, with the remaining 50% due upon final approval prior to asset or site transfer.

Q: Do you offer white-label design services for agencies?
A: Yes, Aqsa regularly partners with design agencies, Webflow studios, and dev teams on white-label contracts.
